XERJ docs: install, ask, index, connect

XERJ is one Rust binary that gives coding agents search: xerj ask answers questions about catalogued open-source projects from signed, pre-indexed packs, xerj autoindex makes your own folders searchable, and xerj mcp exposes both to any MCP client. The node speaks the Elasticsearch wire protocol on :9200 and runs on a single machine. Every key, flag and default on these pages comes out of the Rust crates under engine/crates/; if the docs and the code disagree, the code is right, and a bug report gets the docs fixed.

Get started

01 Install

curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh. One static binary, SHA-256 verified; Linux, macOS, Windows on x86_64 and arm64.

ONE BINARY · FAIL-CLOSED CHECKSUM 02 Ask a hub corpus

xerj "how does lz4 frame format work" pulls one signed pack and answers with file:line, pin and licence.

NO CLONE · FILE:LINE · SIGNED PACKS 03 Index your own folder

Start a node, then xerj autoindex <folder> and xerj search "<words>". Formats are sniffed by content.

ZERO CONFIG · CODE + DOCUMENTS 04 Connect an agent

xerj init registers xerj mcp (17 tools) for Claude Code and Cursor. Tool schemas for MCP, OpenAI and Anthropic.

MCP · 17 TOOLS · LLMS.TXT

Recipes

Task guides, each run end-to-end against a live XERJ node, stdlib-only and reproducible. Browse all recipes →

01 Zero-config autoindex

One command turns JSONL, CSV, SQLite, PDF, DOCX, HTML and log files into typed, queryable indices.

XERJ AUTOINDEX · CONTENT-SNIFFED 02 Index a folder of documents

A recursive folder of PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown and TXT files, extracted, chunked and embedded in one pass.

PDF · DOCX · CHUNKED 03 Air-gapped deployment

Stage a release and an optional neural model on a connected machine, then run the node with no runtime internet access.

OFFLINE · NO NETWORK 04 Semantic search & RAG

Retrieval by meaning with semantic_text — auto-embed on ingest, no separate vector DB.

SEMANTIC_TEXT · AUTO-EMBED · RAG 05 Agent memory

Long-term memory for agents via the /_memory API — store, recall, forget, per-agent isolation.

/_MEMORY · RECALL + FORGET · PER-AGENT 06 Passage retrieval

Auto-chunk long docs; a doc competes on its best passage via max-sim scoring.

CHUNKING · MAX-SIM PASSAGES 07 Vector search · kNN

Nearest-neighbor similarity over dense_vector (HNSW-served unfiltered; exact scan with filters).

DENSE_VECTOR · HNSW + EXACT · FILTERED kNN 08 Vector quantization

Opt a dense_vector into scalar8 (ES int8_hnsw alias) — int8 scoring precision, recall measured in the recipe. Not a memory saving.

SCALAR8 · INT8 PRECISION · MEASURED RECALL 09 Hybrid search

Keyword + vector in one query — results neither BM25 nor kNN ranks first alone.

BM25 + kNN · RRF FUSION 10 Log analytics

From raw logs to dashboards — error rates, p95 latency, top services via aggregations.

DATE_HISTOGRAM · P95 · TOP SERVICES 11 Anomaly detection

Statistical _ml detectors that flag spikes in metrics and logs.

_ML · SPIKE DETECTION · STATISTICAL 12 Anomaly datafeeds

A live _ml datafeed re-scores an index on a timer and stores anomaly records you poll.

_ML DATAFEED · CONTINUOUS · POLL 13 Migrate from Elasticsearch

Point your existing ES client at XERJ — same wire, change the URL.

SAME WIRE · CHANGE THE URL

Playbooks

Classic Elasticsearch workloads, written as complete walk-throughs: a schema, an ingest command, a query, and the dashboard to visualize it.

01 SIEM · Security Analytics

Detect auth spikes, top attacker IPs and anomalies with terms aggregations and detection rules.

TERMS AGG · TOP-N · DETECTION RULES 02 Log Analytics

Nginx, JSON, syslog, OTLP: ingest in-process, query recent logs, aggregate by service.

IN-PROCESS INGEST · NO LOGSTASH · ZSTD 03 Vector · RAG

Embed, index, retrieve with hybrid BM25 + kNN — all on one box.

HNSW + EXACT kNN · SQ8 · HYBRID FUSION 04 Full-Text Search

Classic inverted-index search with BM25, analyzers, highlighters, and query-time boosting.

BM25 · STANDARD ANALYZER · QUERY DSL 05 Observability

Metrics + traces + logs as one queryable store. Prometheus scrape endpoint built in.

OTLP · TRACES · PROM METRICS
